# InfinitePay

> A InfinitePay é uma plataforma financeira para empreendedores no Brasil. Reúne soluções para vender, receber, gerenciar o dinheiro do negócio, acessar crédito e investir — com conta digital integrada, Pix gratuito e meios de pagamento presenciais e online.

## Soluções de pagamento

- [Maquininha Smart](https://www.infinitepay.io/maquininha): Maquininha para vendas presenciais, com cartão, aproximação e Pix.
- [InfiniteTap](https://www.infinitepay.io/maquininha-celular): Transforme um celular Android ou iPhone compatível em maquininha para pagamentos por aproximação.
- [Link de Pagamento](https://www.infinitepay.io/link-de-pagamento): Crie links para cobrar clientes à distância e aceitar pagamentos em até 12x.
- [Pix](https://www.infinitepay.io/pix): Faça e receba pagamentos por Pix sem taxa, pela conta, QR Code, link ou maquininha.
- [Checkout Integrado](https://www.infinitepay.io/checkout): Integre pagamentos por Pix e cartão ao seu site; consulte a [documentação técnica](https://www.infinitepay.io/checkout-documentacao).

## Vendas e gestão do negócio

- [Loja Online](https://www.infinitepay.io/loja-online): Crie uma loja online com catálogo, checkout integrado, Pix e cartão.
- [Gestão de Cobrança](https://www.infinitepay.io/gestao-de-cobranca): Crie cobranças únicas ou recorrentes e envie lembretes automáticos pelo WhatsApp.
- [PDV](https://www.infinitepay.io/pdv): Frente de caixa para cadastrar produtos, registrar vendas, controlar o estoque e emitir fichas no Modo Evento.
- [Agendamento Automático](https://www.infinitepay.io/agendamento-automatico): Organize horários, receba sinal e envie lembretes automáticos aos clientes.
- [Link na Bio](https://www.infinitepay.io/link-na-bio): Reúna links, produtos, redes sociais e formas de pagamento em uma página compartilhável.
- [JIM](https://www.infinitepay.io/jim): Assistente de IA para criar sites e campanhas, apoiar precificação e consolidar relatórios do negócio.

## Conta, crédito e investimentos

- [Conta Digital](https://www.infinitepay.io/conta): Conta integrada para receber vendas, movimentar saldo e acessar soluções financeiras.
- [Conta PJ](https://www.infinitepay.io/conta/pessoa-juridica): Conta para empresas com Pix, cartões, boletos e ferramentas para vender.
- [Conta MEI](https://www.infinitepay.io/conta/mei): Conta gratuita criada para microempreendedores individuais.
- [Cartão de Crédito](https://www.infinitepay.io/cartao-de-credito): Cartão de crédito virtual, internacional e sem anuidade, sujeito à aprovação.
- [Empréstimo](https://www.infinitepay.io/emprestimo): Crédito para o negócio disponível pelo app, sujeito à análise e aprovação.
- [CDB InfinitePay](https://www.infinitepay.io/cdb): Investimento a partir de R$ 1, com rendimento de até 111,11% do CDI e proteção do FGC.
- [Rende Mais](https://www.infinitepay.io/rende-mais): Reserva que recebe automaticamente uma parcela das vendas e rende 101% do CDI, com liquidez diária.
- [Renda Protegida](https://www.infinitepay.io/renda-protegida): Proteção de renda para MEIs e profissionais autônomos.

## Taxas

As condições comerciais, taxas por modalidade, bandeira, faturamento, parcelas e prazo de recebimento estão disponíveis nas páginas abaixo. O Pix é gratuito.

- [Taxas (Markdown)](https://www.infinitepay.io/.well-known/taxas.md): Tabelas de taxas em Markdown.
- [Taxas (HTML)](https://www.infinitepay.io/taxas): Página de taxas da InfinitePay.

## Conteúdo e suporte

- [Central de Ajuda](https://ajuda.infinitepay.io/pt-BR/): Artigos de suporte sobre conta, maquininhas, pagamentos, pedidos e app.
- [Segurança](https://www.infinitepay.io/seguranca): Orientações para proteger a conta e evitar golpes.
- [Canais oficiais de contato](https://www.infinitepay.io/blog/como-entrar-em-contato-com-a-infinitepay): Canais verificados de atendimento, suporte, parcerias e imprensa.
- [Blog InfinitePay](https://www.infinitepay.io/blog): Conteúdos sobre pagamentos, vendas, gestão e empreendedorismo.
- [Materiais e Ferramentas](https://www.infinitepay.io/materiais): Planilhas, calculadoras e materiais gratuitos para negócios.
- [InfiniteAcademy](https://www.infinitepay.io/infinite-academy): Cursos gratuitos para empreendedores.

## Legal e compliance

- [Termos de Uso](https://www.infinitepay.io/legal/termos-de-uso): Termos e condições gerais dos serviços.
- [Aviso de Privacidade](https://www.infinitepay.io/legal/aviso-de-privacidade): Política de tratamento de dados pessoais.

<!-- ===== Restore Params from Cookie (Safari ITP workaround) ===== -->
<script>
    (function () {
        "use strict";

        var COOKIE_NAME = "_exp_ctx";

        // Get cookie value
        var getCookie = function (name) {
            var needle = name + "=";
            var hit = document.cookie.split("; ").find(function (c) { return c.startsWith(needle); });
            return hit ? hit.slice(needle.length) : null;
        };

        // Delete cookie
        var deleteCookie = function (name, domain) {
            document.cookie = name + "=; Path=/; Domain=" + domain + "; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0";
        };

        // Get domain for cookie (e.g., ".jim.com")
        var getCookieDomain = function () {
            var host = window.location.hostname;
            if (host.startsWith("www.")) host = host.slice(4);
            return "." + host;
        };

        try {
            var raw = getCookie(COOKIE_NAME);
            if (!raw) return; // No backup cookie, nothing to do

            var params = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(raw));
            if (!params || typeof params !== "object") return;

            var url = new URL(window.location.href);
            var changed = false;

            // Only restore params that are missing from current URL
            for (var key in params) {
                if (params.hasOwnProperty(key) && !url.searchParams.has(key)) {
                    url.searchParams.set(key, params[key]);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }

            // Update URL if we restored any params
            if (changed && window.history && window.history.replaceState) {
                window.history.replaceState(null, "", url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
            }

            // Always delete the cookie after reading (one-time use)
            deleteCookie(COOKIE_NAME, getCookieDomain());

        } catch (e) {
            // Silently fail - don't break the page
        }
    })();
</script>
<!-- ===== End Restore Params ===== -->

<!-- ===== Utils: cookies/params/persistência (compartilhados) ===== -->
<script>
    (function () {
        "use strict";

        var getCleanDomain = function () { return location.hostname.replace(/^www\./i, ""); };
        var getCookieMap = function () {
            return document.cookie.split("; ").reduce(function (acc, cookie) {
                if (!cookie) return acc;
                var idx = cookie.indexOf("=");
                var key = idx >= 0 ? cookie.slice(0, idx) : cookie;
                var val = idx >= 0 ? cookie.slice(idx + 1) : "";
                acc[key] = val ? decodeURIComponent(val) : "";
                return acc;
            }, {});
        };
        var setCookie = function (name, value, days) {
            if (!name) return;
            var expires = new Date(Date.now() + (days || 30) * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toUTCString();
            var cleanDomain = getCleanDomain();
            document.cookie = name + "=" + encodeURIComponent(value) + "; SameSite=None; Secure; expires=" + expires + "; path=/; domain=." + cleanDomain;
        };
        var parseQuery = function (qs) { return Object.fromEntries(new URLSearchParams(qs).entries()); };
        var lower = function (s) { return (s || "").toString().trim().toLowerCase(); };

        var toStringSafe = function (v) {
            if (v == null) return "";
            if (typeof v === "string") return v;
            try { return JSON.stringify(v); } catch (e) { return String(v); }
        };
        var setData = function (name, value) {
            if (!name) return;
            var s = toStringSafe(value);
            if (!s || s.trim() === "") return;
            try { window.sessionStorage.setItem(name, s); } catch (e) { }
            setCookie(name, s, 30);
        };
        var getData = function (name) {
            var v = null;
            try { v = window.sessionStorage.getItem(name); } catch (e) { }
            if (v) return v;
            var cookies = getCookieMap();
            return cookies[name] || null;
        };
        var getPersistedParams = function () {
            var raw = getData("ifp_search_params");
            if (!raw) return {};
            try { return (typeof raw === "string") ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw; } catch (e) { return {}; }
        };

        // [OPT-4] Helpers compartilhados — elimina 4x duplicação
        window.__ifpHelpers = {
            getCookieMap: getCookieMap,
            getCleanDomain: getCleanDomain,
            parseQuery: parseQuery,
            lower: lower,
            getPersistedParams: getPersistedParams
        };

        var params = parseQuery(window.location.search);

        var clickIds = {
            ifp_ttclid: params.ttclid,
            ifp_fbclid: params.fbclid,
            ifp_gclid: params.gclid,
            ifp_clickid: (lower(params.utm_source) === "kwai" && params.click_id) ? params.click_id : null
        };
        Object.keys(clickIds).forEach(function (k) { if (clickIds[k]) setData(k, clickIds[k]); });
        if (Object.keys(params).length) setData("ifp_search_params", params);

        setData("lp_origin_path", window.location.pathname);
        setData("ifp_original_url", window.location.pathname);
        setData("ifp_original_title", document.title);
        setData("ifp_original_cookies", document.cookie);

        var utmSource = lower(params.utm_source);
        var utmCampaign = lower(params.utm_campaign || params.utm_name);
        var referrerMap = {
            "google": (utmCampaign.includes("youtube") || utmCampaign.includes("demand-gen")) ? "https://www.youtube.com" : "https://www.google.com",
            "fb": "https://m.facebook.com",
            "ig": "https://www.instagram.com",
            "tiktok": "https://www.tiktok.com",
            "kwai": "https://www.kwai.com"
        };
        var referrer = document.referrer || "$direct";
        var hasAdSignals = !!(utmSource || params.gclid || params.fbclid || params.ttclid || params.click_id || params.gbraid || params.wbraid);

        if (hasAdSignals) {
            if (utmSource === "ig" || (params.fbclid && utmSource !== "fb")) {
                referrer = referrerMap["ig"];
            } else if (utmSource === "google") {
                referrer = referrerMap["google"];
            } else if (utmSource && referrerMap[utmSource]) {
                referrer = referrerMap[utmSource];
            } else if (utmSource) {
                if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(utmSource)) {
                    referrer = utmSource;
                } else if (/\./.test(utmSource)) {
                    referrer = "https://" + utmSource;
                } else {
                    referrer = "https://" + utmSource + ".com";
                }
            }
        } else if (referrer !== "$direct") {
            try {
                var refHost = new URL(referrer).hostname;
                if (
                    referrer.startsWith("android-app://") ||
                    referrer.includes("safeframe.googlesyndication.com") ||
                    refHost.includes("infinitepay.io")
                ) {
                    referrer = "$direct";
                }
            } catch (e) {
                referrer = "$direct";
            }
        } else {
            referrer = "$direct";
        }

        setData("ifp_original_referrer", referrer);

        window.getIFPPersistedParams = function () {
            return getPersistedParams();
        };

    })();
</script>

<!-- ===== [OPT-2] Rudder page() + SPA hooks ===== -->
<script>
    (function () {
        "use strict";

        var h = window.__ifpHelpers;

        function buildPagePayload() {
            var cookies = h.getCookieMap();
            var now = h.parseQuery(window.location.search);
            var persisted = h.getPersistedParams();
            var pick = function (k) { return (now[k] != null ? now[k] : persisted[k]) || null; };

            return {
                path: window.location.pathname,
                title: document.title,
                referrer: (cookies["ifp_original_referrer"] && cookies["ifp_original_referrer"].trim() !== "") ? cookies["ifp_original_referrer"] : (document.referrer || "$direct"),
                search: window.location.search,
                url: window.location.href,
                utm_source: pick("utm_source"),
                utm_medium: pick("utm_medium"),
                utm_campaign: pick("utm_campaign") || pick("utm_name"),
                utm_content: pick("utm_content"),
                utm_term: pick("utm_term"),
                ttclid: pick("ttclid"),
                fbclid: pick("fbclid"),
                gclid: pick("gclid"),
                all_cookies: cookies
            };
        }

        function sendPage() {
            try {
                var data = buildPagePayload();
                if (window.rudderanalytics && window.rudderanalytics.page) {
                    window.rudderanalytics.page(data);
                }

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", sendPage);

        (function hookHistory() {

<!-- ===== [OPT-3] Feature Experiments - Exposure (Amplitude) ===== -->
<script>
    (function () {
        "use strict";

        var LS_KEY = "exp_pending_exposure";
        var h = window.__ifpHelpers;
        var cookies = h.getCookieMap();
        var assignment = cookies["exp_assignment"];
        var flagKey, variant, expDeviceId, source;

        if (assignment) {
            var sep = assignment.indexOf(":");
            if (sep >= 1) {
                flagKey = assignment.substring(0, sep);
                variant = assignment.substring(sep + 1);
                source = "cookie";
            }
        }

        if (!flagKey || !variant) {
            var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            flagKey = params.get("_exp_flag") || "";
            variant = params.get("_exp_variant") || "";
            if (flagKey && variant) source = "query_param";
        }

        if (!flagKey || !variant) {
            try {
                var stored = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY);
                if (stored) {
                    var pending = JSON.parse(stored);
                    if (pending.status === "beacon_sent") {
                        localStorage.removeItem(LS_KEY);
                    } else if (pending.flagKey && pending.variant && pending.status === "pending") {
                        flagKey = pending.flagKey;
                        variant = pending.variant;
                        expDeviceId = pending.expDeviceId || "";
                        source = "localStorage_retry";
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) { }
        }

        if (!flagKey || !variant) return;

        if (!expDeviceId) expDeviceId = cookies["exp_device_id"] || "";
        if (!expDeviceId) {
            var qp = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            expDeviceId = qp.get("_exp_device_id") || "";
        }

        var cleanDomain = h.getCleanDomain();

        if (window.history && window.history.replaceState) {
            var url = new URL(window.location.href);
            if (url.searchParams.has("_exp_flag") || url.searchParams.has("_exp_variant") || url.searchParams.has("_exp_device_id")) {
                url.searchParams.delete("_exp_flag");
                url.searchParams.delete("_exp_variant");
                url.searchParams.delete("_exp_device_id");
                window.__expCleaningParams = true;
                window.history.replaceState(null, "", url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
                window.__expCleaningParams = false;
            }
        }

        try {
            localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify({
                flagKey: flagKey,
                variant: variant,
                expDeviceId: expDeviceId,
                status: "pending",
                ts: Date.now()
            }));
        } catch (e) { }

        var exposureFired = false;

        function fireExposure() {
            rudderanalytics.track("$exposure", {
                flag_key: flagKey,
                variant: variant,
                exp_device_id: expDeviceId
            }, {}, function () {
                exposureFired = true;
                document.cookie = "exp_assignment=; Path=/; Domain=." + cleanDomain + "; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0";
                try { localStorage.removeItem(LS_KEY); } catch (e) { }
            });
        }

        document.addEventListener("pagehide", function () {
            if (exposureFired) return;
            if (navigator.sendBeacon) {
                var sent = navigator.sendBeacon("/exp/exposure-fallback", JSON.stringify({
                    flag_key: flagKey,
                    variant: variant,
                    exp_device_id: expDeviceId,

    function hasRenderedQr(el) {
        return !!(el.querySelector("canvas, svg") || el.querySelector("img[data-af-qr-img]"));

    function injectQrFallback(el) {
        if (!el || el.getAttribute("data-af-qr") === "fallback") return;
        if (hasRenderedQr(el)) return;

        el.innerHTML = "";

            el.setAttribute("data-af-qr-url", ONELINK_BASE);
        }

    function ensureQrFallbacks() {
        document.querySelectorAll("[data-qrcode]").forEach(injectQrFallback);
    }

    function scheduleFallbackChecks() {
        FALLBACK_CHECK_DELAYS.forEach(function (delay) {
            setTimeout(ensureQrFallbacks, delay);
        });

    function renderQr(el, config, expectedURL) {
        if (!el || !expectedURL) return;

        var again = window.AF_SMART_SCRIPT.generateOneLinkURL(config);

        el.innerHTML = "";
        el.removeAttribute("data-af-qr");
        window.AF_SMART_SCRIPT.displayQrCode(el.id, { codeColor: "#000000" });
        el.setAttribute("data-af-qr-url", expectedURL);

    function applyKey(key, anonId) {

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-qrcode="' + key + '"]').forEach(function (el) {

<script async>
(function(){
var second = 1000,
    minute = second * 60,
    hour = minute * 60,
    day = hour * 24;

function getNextSunday(date) {
    var dayOfWeek = date.getDay();
    var daysToNextSunday = (7 - dayOfWeek) % 7 || 7;

    var nextSunday = new Date(date);
    nextSunday.setDate(date.getDate() + daysToNextSunday);
    nextSunday.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999)

    return nextSunday;
}

var countDown = getNextSunday(new Date()).getTime(),
    x = setInterval(function() {

        var now = new Date().getTime(),
            distance = countDown - now;

        if (distance < 0) {
            countDown = getNextSunday(new Date()).getTime()
        }

        var daysElem = document.getElementById('days');
        var hoursElem = document.getElementById('hours');
        var minutesElem = document.getElementById('minutes');
        var secondsElem = document.getElementById('seconds');

        if (!daysElem || !hoursElem || !minutesElem || !secondsElem) {
            return;
        }

        daysElem.innerText = Math.floor(distance / (day));
        hoursElem.innerText = Math.floor((distance % (day)) / (hour));
        minutesElem.innerText = Math.floor((distance % (hour)) / (minute));
        secondsElem.innerText = Math.floor((distance % (minute)) / second);

    }, second);
})();
</script>

<script>
(() => {
    const WHITELIST = new Set([
        "utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign", "utm_content", "utm_term", "utm_name",
        "gclid", "fbclid", "click_id", "ttclid"
    ]);

    const STORAGE = window.sessionStorage;
    const KEY = "ifp_persist_query_params";

    const pickParams = (sp) => {
        const out = new URLSearchParams();
        for (const [k, v] of sp.entries()) {
            if (WHITELIST.has(k) && v) out.set(k, v);
        }
        return out;
    };

    const currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
    const incomingPicked = pickParams(currentUrl.searchParams);

    if ([...incomingPicked.keys()].length) {
        STORAGE.setItem(KEY, incomingPicked.toString());
    }

    const storedStr = STORAGE.getItem(KEY) || "";
    if (!storedStr) return;

    const stored = new URLSearchParams(storedStr);

    // Replacestate pra manter UTMs na URL se user copiar link
    let changed = false;
    for (const [k, v] of stored.entries()) {
        if (!currentUrl.searchParams.has(k)) {
            currentUrl.searchParams.set(k, v);
            changed = true;
        }
    }
    if (changed) {
        history.replaceState({}, "", currentUrl.pathname + "?" + currentUrl.searchParams.toString() + currentUrl.hash);
    }

    // Aceita links internos E cross-subdomain (.infinitepay.io)
    const isOwnLink = (a) => {
        const href = a.getAttribute("href") || "";
        if (!href || href.startsWith("#") || href.startsWith("mailto:") || href.startsWith("tel:") || href.startsWith("javascript:")) return false;
        try {
            const u = new URL(href, window.location.origin);
            return u.hostname.endsWith(".infinitepay.io") || u.origin === window.location.origin;
        } catch { return false; }
    };

    const withStoredParams = (href) => {
        const u = new URL(href, window.location.origin);
        for (const [k, v] of stored.entries()) {
            if (!u.searchParams.has(k)) u.searchParams.set(k, v);
        }
        return u.toString();
    };

    const updateAllLinks = () => {
        document.querySelectorAll("a[href]").forEach(a => {
            if (!isOwnLink(a)) return;
            a.setAttribute("href", withStoredParams(a.getAttribute("href")));
        });
    };

    // Catch clicks dinâmicos (CMS, scripts que inserem links depois)
    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("a[href]");
        if (!a || !isOwnLink(a)) return;
        a.setAttribute("href", withStoredParams(a.getAttribute("href")));
    }, true);

    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", updateAllLinks);
    } else {
        updateAllLinks();
    }
})();
</script>

      );

      clean(f);
      Array.from(f.children).forEach(clean);

  else window.addEventListener("load", run);
})();

<!-- webview script -->
<script>
(function () {
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var hasSourceApp = params.get('source') === 'app';
  var isInfinitePayUA = /InfinitePayApp/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
  var storageKey = 'force_source_app';

  if (hasSourceApp || isInfinitePayUA) {
    sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey, '1');
  }

  var shouldForceApp = sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey) === '1';

  if (!shouldForceApp) return;

  document.documentElement.classList.add('is-webview');

  if (params.get('source') !== 'app') {
    params.set('source', 'app');
    var newUrl =
      window.location.pathname +
      '?' +
      params.toString() +
      window.location.hash;
    history.replaceState(null, '', newUrl);
  }

  function patchLink(a) {
    var href = a.getAttribute('href');
    if (!href || href.startsWith('#') || href.startsWith('javascript:')) return;

    var url = new URL(href, window.location.origin);
    if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return;

    url.searchParams.set('source', 'app');
    a.setAttribute('href', url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(patchLink);

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href]');
    if (a) patchLink(a);
  }, true);

  document.querySelectorAll('form[method="get"]').forEach(function (form) {
    var action = form.getAttribute('action') || window.location.pathname;
    var url = new URL(action, window.location.origin);
    if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return;

    var input = form.querySelector('input[name="source"]');
    if (!input) {
      input = document.createElement('input');
      input.type = 'hidden';
      input.name = 'source';
      form.appendChild(input);
    }
    input.value = 'app';
  });
})();
</script>

<!-- ===== Restore Params from Cookie (Safari ITP workaround) ===== -->
<script>
    (function () {
        "use strict";

        var COOKIE_NAME = "_exp_ctx";

        // Get cookie value
        var getCookie = function (name) {
            var needle = name + "=";
            var hit = document.cookie.split("; ").find(function (c) { return c.startsWith(needle); });
            return hit ? hit.slice(needle.length) : null;
        };

        // Delete cookie
        var deleteCookie = function (name, domain) {
            document.cookie = name + "=; Path=/; Domain=" + domain + "; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0";
        };

        // Get domain for cookie (e.g., ".jim.com")
        var getCookieDomain = function () {
            var host = window.location.hostname;
            if (host.startsWith("www.")) host = host.slice(4);
            return "." + host;
        };

        try {
            var raw = getCookie(COOKIE_NAME);
            if (!raw) return; // No backup cookie, nothing to do

            var params = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(raw));
            if (!params || typeof params !== "object") return;

            var url = new URL(window.location.href);
            var changed = false;

            // Only restore params that are missing from current URL
            for (var key in params) {
                if (params.hasOwnProperty(key) && !url.searchParams.has(key)) {
                    url.searchParams.set(key, params[key]);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }

            // Update URL if we restored any params
            if (changed && window.history && window.history.replaceState) {
                window.history.replaceState(null, "", url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
            }

            // Always delete the cookie after reading (one-time use)
            deleteCookie(COOKIE_NAME, getCookieDomain());

        } catch (e) {
            // Silently fail - don't break the page
        }
    })();
</script>
<!-- ===== End Restore Params ===== -->

<!-- ===== Utils: cookies/params/persistência (compartilhados) ===== -->
<script>
    (function () {
        "use strict";

        var getCleanDomain = function () { return location.hostname.replace(/^www\./i, ""); };
        var getCookieMap = function () {
            return document.cookie.split("; ").reduce(function (acc, cookie) {
                if (!cookie) return acc;
                var idx = cookie.indexOf("=");
                var key = idx >= 0 ? cookie.slice(0, idx) : cookie;
                var val = idx >= 0 ? cookie.slice(idx + 1) : "";
                acc[key] = val ? decodeURIComponent(val) : "";
                return acc;
            }, {});
        };
        var setCookie = function (name, value, days) {
            if (!name) return;
            var expires = new Date(Date.now() + (days || 30) * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toUTCString();
            var cleanDomain = getCleanDomain();
            document.cookie = name + "=" + encodeURIComponent(value) + "; SameSite=None; Secure; expires=" + expires + "; path=/; domain=." + cleanDomain;
        };
        var parseQuery = function (qs) { return Object.fromEntries(new URLSearchParams(qs).entries()); };
        var lower = function (s) { return (s || "").toString().trim().toLowerCase(); };

        var toStringSafe = function (v) {
            if (v == null) return "";
            if (typeof v === "string") return v;
            try { return JSON.stringify(v); } catch (e) { return String(v); }
        };
        var setData = function (name, value) {
            if (!name) return;
            var s = toStringSafe(value);
            if (!s || s.trim() === "") return;
            try { window.sessionStorage.setItem(name, s); } catch (e) { }
            setCookie(name, s, 30);
        };
        var getData = function (name) {
            var v = null;
            try { v = window.sessionStorage.getItem(name); } catch (e) { }
            if (v) return v;
            var cookies = getCookieMap();
            return cookies[name] || null;
        };
        var getPersistedParams = function () {
            var raw = getData("ifp_search_params");
            if (!raw) return {};
            try { return (typeof raw === "string") ? JSON.parse(raw) : raw; } catch (e) { return {}; }
        };

        // [OPT-4] Helpers compartilhados — elimina 4x duplicação
        window.__ifpHelpers = {
            getCookieMap: getCookieMap,
            getCleanDomain: getCleanDomain,
            parseQuery: parseQuery,
            lower: lower,
            getPersistedParams: getPersistedParams
        };

        var params = parseQuery(window.location.search);

        var clickIds = {
            ifp_ttclid: params.ttclid,
            ifp_fbclid: params.fbclid,
            ifp_gclid: params.gclid,
            ifp_clickid: (lower(params.utm_source) === "kwai" && params.click_id) ? params.click_id : null
        };
        Object.keys(clickIds).forEach(function (k) { if (clickIds[k]) setData(k, clickIds[k]); });
        if (Object.keys(params).length) setData("ifp_search_params", params);

        setData("lp_origin_path", window.location.pathname);
        setData("ifp_original_url", window.location.pathname);
        setData("ifp_original_title", document.title);
        setData("ifp_original_cookies", document.cookie);

        var utmSource = lower(params.utm_source);
        var utmCampaign = lower(params.utm_campaign || params.utm_name);
        var referrerMap = {
            "google": (utmCampaign.includes("youtube") || utmCampaign.includes("demand-gen")) ? "https://www.youtube.com" : "https://www.google.com",
            "fb": "https://m.facebook.com",
            "ig": "https://www.instagram.com",
            "tiktok": "https://www.tiktok.com",
            "kwai": "https://www.kwai.com"
        };
        var referrer = document.referrer || "$direct";
        var hasAdSignals = !!(utmSource || params.gclid || params.fbclid || params.ttclid || params.click_id || params.gbraid || params.wbraid);

        if (hasAdSignals) {
            if (utmSource === "ig" || (params.fbclid && utmSource !== "fb")) {
                referrer = referrerMap["ig"];
            } else if (utmSource === "google") {
                referrer = referrerMap["google"];
            } else if (utmSource && referrerMap[utmSource]) {
                referrer = referrerMap[utmSource];
            } else if (utmSource) {
                if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(utmSource)) {
                    referrer = utmSource;
                } else if (/\./.test(utmSource)) {
                    referrer = "https://" + utmSource;
                } else {
                    referrer = "https://" + utmSource + ".com";
                }
            }
        } else if (referrer !== "$direct") {
            try {
                var refHost = new URL(referrer).hostname;
                if (
                    referrer.startsWith("android-app://") ||
                    referrer.includes("safeframe.googlesyndication.com") ||
                    refHost.includes("infinitepay.io")
                ) {
                    referrer = "$direct";
                }
            } catch (e) {
                referrer = "$direct";
            }
        } else {
            referrer = "$direct";
        }

        setData("ifp_original_referrer", referrer);

        window.getIFPPersistedParams = function () {
            return getPersistedParams();
        };

    })();
</script>

<script>
    (function () {
        "use strict";

        var LS_KEY = "exp_pending_exposure";
        var h = window.__ifpHelpers;
        var cookies = h.getCookieMap();
        var assignment = cookies["exp_assignment"];
        var flagKey, variant, expDeviceId, source;

        if (assignment) {
            var sep = assignment.indexOf(":");
            if (sep >= 1) {
                flagKey = assignment.substring(0, sep);
                variant = assignment.substring(sep + 1);
                source = "cookie";
            }
        }

        if (!flagKey || !variant) {
            var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            flagKey = params.get("_exp_flag") || "";
            variant = params.get("_exp_variant") || "";
            if (flagKey && variant) source = "query_param";
        }

        if (!flagKey || !variant) {
            try {
                var stored = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY);
                if (stored) {
                    var pending = JSON.parse(stored);
                    if (pending.status === "beacon_sent") {
                        localStorage.removeItem(LS_KEY);
                    } else if (pending.flagKey && pending.variant && pending.status === "pending") {
                        flagKey = pending.flagKey;
                        variant = pending.variant;
                        expDeviceId = pending.expDeviceId || "";
                        source = "localStorage_retry";
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) { }
        }

        if (!flagKey || !variant) return;

        if (!expDeviceId) expDeviceId = cookies["exp_device_id"] || "";
        if (!expDeviceId) {
            var qp = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            expDeviceId = qp.get("_exp_device_id") || "";
        }

        var cleanDomain = h.getCleanDomain();

        if (window.history && window.history.replaceState) {
            var url = new URL(window.location.href);
            if (url.searchParams.has("_exp_flag") || url.searchParams.has("_exp_variant") || url.searchParams.has("_exp_device_id")) {
                url.searchParams.delete("_exp_flag");
                url.searchParams.delete("_exp_variant");
                url.searchParams.delete("_exp_device_id");
                window.__expCleaningParams = true;
                window.history.replaceState(null, "", url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
                window.__expCleaningParams = false;
            }
        }

        try {
            localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify({
                flagKey: flagKey,
                variant: variant,
                expDeviceId: expDeviceId,
                status: "pending",
                ts: Date.now()
            }));
        } catch (e) { }

        var exposureFired = false;

        function fireExposure() {
            rudderanalytics.track("$exposure", {
                flag_key: flagKey,
                variant: variant,
                exp_device_id: expDeviceId
            }, {}, function () {
                exposureFired = true;
                document.cookie = "exp_assignment=; Path=/; Domain=." + cleanDomain + "; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0";
                try { localStorage.removeItem(LS_KEY); } catch (e) { }
            });
        }

        document.addEventListener("pagehide", function () {
            if (exposureFired) return;
            if (navigator.sendBeacon) {
                var sent = navigator.sendBeacon("/exp/exposure-fallback", JSON.stringify({
                    flag_key: flagKey,
                    variant: variant,
                    exp_device_id: expDeviceId,
                    ts: Date.now()
                }));
                if (sent) {
                    exposureFired = true;
                    try {
                        localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY, JSON.stringify({
                            flagKey: flagKey,
                            variant: variant,
                            expDeviceId: expDeviceId,
                            status: "beacon_sent",
                            ts: Date.now()
                        }));
                    } catch (e) { }
                }
            }
        });

        fireExposure();

    })();
</script>

      type = "d";
    }

    if (!date) {
      date = new Date();
    }

    const increase = {
      d: 0,
      m: 0,
      y: 0,
    };

    increase[type] = qtd;

    return new Date(
      date.getFullYear() + increase.y,
      date.getMonth() + increase.m,
      date.getDate() + increase.d
    );
  };

        Origin: document?.location?.origin,
      },
    })
      .then((response) => response.json())
      .catch((err) => {
        return null;
      });

    const documentNumber =
      payload?.url?.replace(/^(?:.*)\/([\d]+)/, "$1") || "";

      .catch(() => {
        return null;

<script>
  const API_CONFIG = {
    url: "https://infinitepay-communication-api.services.production.infinitepay.io/comm/api/whatsapp-widget/clicks",
  };

  const PHONE_NUMBER = "5511953255030";

  const DEFAULT_MESSAGE =
    "Olá, estou interessado em saber mais sobre a InfinitePay";

  const API_TIMEOUT_MS = 2000;

  function getWhatsappRedirectParams() {
    const anonId =
      typeof window?.rudderanalytics?.getAnonymousId === "function"
        ? window.rudderanalytics.getAnonymousId()
        : "anonymous";

    const href = window.location.href.split("?")[0] || "";

    let utmParams = {};
    try {
      const cookieString = document.cookie
        .split(";")
        .find((c) => c.trim().startsWith("ifp_search_params="));

      if (cookieString) {
        const cookieValue = cookieString.split("=")[1];
        if (cookieValue) {
          utmParams = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(cookieValue));
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Error parsing UTM params from cookie:", err);
    }

    return { anonId, href, utmParams };
  }

  function trackWhatsappEvent(action, extras = {}) {
    if (window?.rudderanalytics) {
      window.rudderanalytics.track("WhatsApp Conversation", {
        action,
        phone_number: PHONE_NUMBER,
        ...extras,
      });
    }
  }

  async function getWhatsappUrl(message = DEFAULT_MESSAGE) {
    const { anonId, href, utmParams } = getWhatsappRedirectParams();

    try {
      const response = await Promise.race([
        fetch(API_CONFIG.url, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            anon_id: anonId,
            href,
            ifb_params: utmParams,
            message,
          }),
        }),
        new Promise((_, reject) =>
          setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("Timeout")), API_TIMEOUT_MS)
        ),
      ]);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }

      const data = await response.json();

      trackWhatsappEvent("clicked", {
        href,
        chat_id: data.chat_id,
        ifb_params: utmParams,
      });

      return data.redirect_url;
    } catch (error) {
      trackWhatsappEvent("error", {
        href,
        chat_id: null,
        ifb_params: utmParams,
        error: error.message,
      });

      console.error("Error generating WhatsApp URL:", error);
      return `https://wa.me/${PHONE_NUMBER}?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`;
    }
  }

  function isMobileOrSafari() {
    const ua = navigator.userAgent;
    if (/Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(ua)) {
      return true;
    }
    return /Safari/i.test(ua) && !/Chrome/i.test(ua);
  }

  function initWhatsappWidget() {
    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll("#whatsapp-button");
    if (!buttons.length) return;

    buttons.forEach((button) => {
      let pending = false;

      button.addEventListener("click", async (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (pending) return;
        pending = true;

        const container = button.closest(".whatsapp-container");
        container?.classList.add("loading");

        const newTab = isMobileOrSafari() ? null : window.open("", "_blank");

        try {
          const message =
            button.getAttribute("data-message") || DEFAULT_MESSAGE;
          const url = await getWhatsappUrl(message);

          if (newTab && !newTab.closed) {
            newTab.opener = null;
            newTab.location.href = url;
          } else {
            window.location.href = url;
          }
        } catch {
          if (newTab && !newTab.closed) newTab.close();
        } finally {
          container?.classList.remove("loading");
          pending = false;
        }
      });
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initWhatsappWidget);
</script>

    [...log.children].forEach((li) => {
      li.classList.add("is-gone");
      setTimeout(() => li.remove(), 400);
    });
  };

  const ask = (i) => {
    const [mode, q, a] = ASKS[i];
    halt();
    root.classList.remove("is-sent");
    root.dataset.mode = mode;
    input.textContent = "";
    let n = 0;
    typing = setInterval(() => {
      input.textContent = q.slice(0, ++n);
      input.scrollLeft = input.scrollWidth;
      if (n < q.length) return;
      clearInterval(typing);
      root.classList.add("is-sent");
      later(() => {
        root.classList.remove("is-sent");
        delete root.dataset.mode;
        input.textContent = "";
        clear();

        }, 900);
      }, 1100);
    }, 30);
  };

    if (document.hidden) return;
    cur = (cur + 1) % ASKS.length;
    ask(cur);
  };

  const start = () => {
    if (running) return;
    running = true;
    later(() => {
      next();
      loop = setInterval(next, CYCLE);
    }, 1800);

// Função para extrair o número e o texto adicional
function extractNumberAndText(element) {
    const content = element.textContent.trim();
    const match = content.match(/^(\D*)(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)(\D*)$/);
    if (match) {
        return {
            prefix: match[1],
            number: parseFloat(match[2]),
            suffix: match[3]
        };
    }
    return { prefix: '', number: 0, suffix: '' };
}

// Função para animar o número
function animateNumber(element, target, duration, isDecimal) {
    let start = null;
    const { prefix, number: startValue, suffix } = extractNumberAndText(element);

    function step(timestamp) {
        if (!start) start = timestamp;
        const progress = Math.min((timestamp - start) / duration, 1);
        const current = startValue + progress * (target - startValue);

        const formattedNumber = isDecimal ? current.toFixed(1) : Math.floor(current);
        element.textContent = `${prefix}${formattedNumber}${suffix}`;

        if (progress < 1) {
            window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
        }
    }

    window.requestAnimationFrame(step);
}

// Função principal que será chamada quando o DOM estiver pronto
function initAnimatedNumbers() {
    const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.animated-number');
    
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
            if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                const el = entry.target;
                const target = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('count-target'));
                const duration = parseInt(el.getAttribute('count-duration'));
                const delay = parseInt(el.getAttribute('count-delay'));
                const isDecimal = el.getAttribute('count-decimal') === 'true';
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                    animateNumber(el, target, duration, isDecimal);
                }, delay);
                
                observer.unobserve(el);
            }
        });
    }, { threshold: 1 });

    elements.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
}

// Verifica se o documento já está pronto ou se precisa esperar o evento DOMContentLoaded
if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initAnimatedNumbers);
} else {
    initAnimatedNumbers();
}

// ============================================================================
// 1. CONFIGURATION & CONSTANTS
// ============================================================================

const CONFIG = {
    CDI_RATE_DAILY: 0.052531, // fallback (~14,15% a.a.) — sobrescrito pela API do BCB
    SAVINGS_MONTHLY_RATE: 0.006767, // Savings account monthly rate
    MIN_CDB_DAYS: 31, // Minimum CDB investment period
    INITIAL_PU: 0.01 // Initial Unit Price
};
// ============================================================================
// 1b. CDI RATE PROVIDER (BCB API)
// Série 12 = CDI diário (% ao dia). Série 11 (Selic) retorna o mesmo valor.
// Docs: https://dadosabertos.bcb.gov.br/dataset/11-taxa-de-juros---selic
// ============================================================================

const CdiRateProvider = {
    API_URL: 'https://api.bcb.gov.br/dados/serie/bcdata.sgs.12/dados/ultimos/1?formato=json',
    CACHE_KEY: 'cdb_cdi_rate_daily',
    CACHE_DATE_KEY: 'cdb_cdi_rate_date',

    getTodayKey: () => {
        const now = new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo' }));
        const yyyy = now.getFullYear();
        const mm = String(now.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        const dd = String(now.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
        return `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;
    },

    getCached: () => {
        try {
            if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return null;
            const date = sessionStorage.getItem(CdiRateProvider.CACHE_DATE_KEY);
            const rate = parseFloat(sessionStorage.getItem(CdiRateProvider.CACHE_KEY));
            if (date === CdiRateProvider.getTodayKey() && Number.isFinite(rate) && rate > 0) {
                return rate;
            }
        } catch (e) { /* storage indisponível */ }
        return null;
    },

    setCache: (rate) => {
        try {
            if (typeof sessionStorage === 'undefined') return;
            sessionStorage.setItem(CdiRateProvider.CACHE_KEY, String(rate));
            sessionStorage.setItem(CdiRateProvider.CACHE_DATE_KEY, CdiRateProvider.getTodayKey());
        } catch (e) { /* storage indisponível */ }
    },

    fetchLatest: async () => {
        const cached = CdiRateProvider.getCached();
        if (cached !== null) {
            CONFIG.CDI_RATE_DAILY = cached;
            return cached;
        }

        try {
            const res = await fetch(CdiRateProvider.API_URL);
            if (!res.ok) throw new Error('BCB API status ' + res.status);

            const data = await res.json();
            if (!Array.isArray(data) || !data.length) throw new Error('BCB API empty response');

            const rate = parseFloat(data[data.length - 1].valor);
            if (!Number.isFinite(rate) || rate <= 0) throw new Error('BCB API invalid rate');

            CONFIG.CDI_RATE_DAILY = rate;
            CdiRateProvider.setCache(rate);
            return rate;
        } catch (err) {
            console.warn('[CDB] CDI fetch failed, using fallback:', err);
            return CONFIG.CDI_RATE_DAILY;
        }
    }
};

const TERM_PRESETS = [1, 6, 12, 24];
const CDI_RATE_UP_TO_89 = 102; // up to 89 days
const CDI_RATE_FROM_90 = 106; // from 90 days
const CDI_RATE_FROM_1_YEAR = 111.11; // from 1 year
const CDI_RATE_DAILY_LIQUIDITY = 101; // daily liquidity, any term
const CDI_DAYS_TIER_90 = 90;

// ============================================================================
// 2. CORE UTILITIES (Math & Date)
// ============================================================================

const Utils = {
    /**
     * Truncate to N decimal places (Standard truncation)
     */
    truncate: (value, decimals) => {
        const multiplier = Math.pow(10, decimals);
        return Math.trunc(value * multiplier) / multiplier;
    },

    /**
     * Truncate to 2 decimal places specifically for Taxes
     */
    truncateTo2: (value) => {
        const scaled = value * 100;
        const truncated = Math.trunc(scaled);
        return truncated / 100;
    },

    /**
     * Format number as BRL currency
     */
    formatCurrency: (value) => {
        return value.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2,
            maximumFractionDigits: 2
        });
    },

    formatYield: (value) => {
        const prefix = value >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
        return `${prefix}R$ ${Utils.formatCurrency(Math.abs(value))}`;
    },

    /**
     * Format a CDI percentage without trailing zeros (ex: 111,11 / 106 / 101)
     */
    formatRate: (rate) => {
        return rate.toLocaleString('pt-BR', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
    },

    /**
     * Parse BRL currency string to float
     */
    parseCurrency: (input) => {
        if (typeof input !== 'string') return input;
        let clean = input.replace(/[R$\s.]/g, '').replace(',', '.');
        return parseFloat(clean) || 0;
    }
};

// ============================================================================
// 3. CALENDAR ENGINE
// ============================================================================

const Calendar = {
    isBusinessDay: (date) => {
        const day = date.getDay();
        if (day === 0 || day === 6) return false; // Weekend

        const yyyy = date.getFullYear();
        const mm = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
        const dd = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
        const dateStr = `${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`;

        return !HOLIDAYS.includes(dateStr);
    },

    getNextBusinessDay: (date) => {
        let next = new Date(date);
        if (Calendar.isBusinessDay(next)) return next;

        while (true) {
            next.setDate(next.getDate() + 1);
            if (Calendar.isBusinessDay(next)) return next;
        }
    },

    /**
     * Counts business days forward from startDate for periodDays calendar days
     * Returns count of business days in the period [startDate, startDate + periodDays)
     * Note: The end date is EXCLUSIVE
     */
    countFutureBusinessDays: (startDate, periodDays) => {
        let count = 0;
        let current = new Date(startDate);
        current.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        const endDate = new Date(startDate);
        endDate.setDate(endDate.getDate() + periodDays);
        endDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

        while (current.getTime() < endDate.getTime()) {
            if (Calendar.isBusinessDay(current)) {
                count++;
            }
            current.setDate(current.getDate() + 1);
        }
        return count;
    }
};

// 4. TAX CALCULATOR
// ============================================================================

const TaxCalculator = {
    // IOF (Imposto sobre Operações Financeiras) Table
    // Regressive tax applied only in the first 30 days
    getIOFRate: (days) => {
        if (days >= 30 || days < 0) return 0;
        const rates = {
            0: 0, 1: 0.96, 2: 0.93, 3: 0.90, 4: 0.86, 5: 0.83, 6: 0.80, 7: 0.76, 8: 0.73, 9: 0.70,
            10: 0.66, 11: 0.63, 12: 0.60, 13: 0.56, 14: 0.53, 15: 0.50, 16: 0.46, 17: 0.43, 18: 0.40,
            19: 0.36, 20: 0.33, 21: 0.30, 22: 0.26, 23: 0.23, 24: 0.20, 25: 0.16, 26: 0.13, 27: 0.10,
            28: 0.06, 29: 0.03
        };
        return rates[days] || 0;
    },

    // IR (Imposto de Renda) Table - Regressive income tax
    getIRRate: (days) => {
        if (days <= 180) return 0.225;    // 22.5%
        if (days <= 360) return 0.20;     // 20.0%
        if (days <= 720) return 0.175;    // 17.5%
        return 0.15;                      // 15.0%
    }
};

// ============================================================================
// 5. YIELD CALCULATOR
// ============================================================================

const YieldCalculator = {
    /**
     * Calculates PU (Unit Price) evolution for one day
     * Uses PU-based calculation method for CDB yield
     */
    calculateDay: (currentPU, principal, cdiRateDaily, cdbPercentage) => {
        // Calculate daily yield rate
        const rateDecimal = cdbPercentage / 100;
        const dailyRate = (cdiRateDaily * rateDecimal) / 100;

        // Calculate new PU
        const newPURaw = currentPU * (1 + dailyRate);

        // Truncate PU to 16 decimals (for storage/next iteration)
        const newPU = Utils.truncate(newPURaw, 16);

        // Truncate PU to 8 decimals (for calculation)
        const puTruncated = Utils.truncate(newPU, 8);

        // Calculate position and yield
        const quantity = principal / CONFIG.INITIAL_PU;
        const grossPosition = quantity * puTruncated;
        const grossYield = grossPosition - principal;

        return {
            newPU,          // For next iteration
            grossYield,     // Accumulated yield
            grossPosition   // Total position
        };
    }
};

// ============================================================================
// 6b. CHART (markers & bar heights)
// ============================================================================

const Chart = {
    roundToZeroOrFive: (value) => {
        const n = Math.round(value);
        const last = n % 10;

        if (last <= 2) return n - last;
        if (last <= 7) return n - last + 5;
        return n - last + 10;
    },

    roundMarkerLabelValue: (value) => {
        if (value <= 0) return 0;

        const v = Math.round(value * 100) / 100;

        if (v < 1) {
            return Math.max(0.01, v);
        }

        if (v < 1000) {
            return Chart.roundToZeroOrFive(v);
        }

        return Chart.roundMiddleValue(v);
    },

    roundMiddleValue: (value) => {
        if (value <= 0) return 1;

        const v = Math.round(value * 100) / 100;

        if (v >= 1_000_000) {
            return Math.round(v / 10_000) * 10_000;
        }

        if (v >= 10_000) {
            return Math.round(v / 100) * 100;
        }

        if (v >= 1000) {
            return Math.round(v / 10) * 10;
        }

        if (v >= 100) {
            return Math.round(v / 10) * 10;
        }

        if (v >= 10) {
            return Math.round(v);
        }

        return Math.max(0.01, Math.round(v * 100) / 100);
    },

    getMinIncrement: (value) => {
        if (value >= 1_000_000) return 10_000;
        if (value >= 100_000) return 1_000;
        if (value >= 10_000) return 10;
        if (value >= 1_000) return 1;
        if (value >= 100) return 0.1;
        return 0.01;
    },

    ensureDistinct: (top, middle, bottom) => {
        let t = Chart.roundMarkerLabelValue(top);
        let m = Chart.roundMarkerLabelValue(middle);
        let b = Chart.roundMarkerLabelValue(bottom);

        const getInc = (value) => {
            if (value >= 1000) return Chart.getMinIncrement(value);
            if (value >= 1) return 5;
            return 0.01;
        };

        if (t <= m) t = m + getInc(m);
        if (b >= m) b = Math.max(m - getInc(m), getInc(m));
        if (b <= 0) b = Math.max(m - getInc(m), getInc(m));

        if (t === m) t = m + (m >= 1 ? 5 : 0.01);
        if (b === m) b = Math.max(m - (m >= 1 ? 5 : 0.01), m >= 1 ? 5 : 0.01);

        return {
            top: Chart.roundMarkerLabelValue(t),
            middle: Chart.roundMarkerLabelValue(m),
            bottom: Chart.roundMarkerLabelValue(b)
        };
    },

    roundTopValue: (value) => {
        if (value <= 0) return 1;

        const rounded = Chart.roundMiddleValue(value);
        if (rounded >= value) return rounded;

        const inc = Chart.getMinIncrement(rounded);
        return Math.round((rounded + inc) * 100) / 100;
    },

    getCdi100ReferenceYield: (principal) => {
        if (principal <= 0) return 0;
        return CdbSimulator.simulate(principal, CHART_REFERENCE_MONTHS, 100).netYield;
    },

    // Scale stays on the scheduled max in both tabs so the daily column visibly drops
    getCdbReferenceYield24: (principal) => {
        if (principal <= 0) return 0;
        return CdbSimulator.simulate(principal, CHART_MAX_TERM_MONTHS, CDI_RATE_FROM_1_YEAR).netYield;
    },

    getMarkers: (principal) => {
        if (principal <= 0) {
            return { top: 1, middle: 1, bottom: 0.5, scaleMiddle: 1, scaleTop: 1 };
        }

        const cdi100Yield12 = Chart.getCdi100ReferenceYield(principal);
        const cdbYield24 = Chart.getCdbReferenceYield24(principal);

        const baseMiddle = Chart.roundMiddleValue(cdi100Yield12);
        const middle = Chart.roundMiddleValue(baseMiddle * MARKER_MIDDLE_SCALE);
        const rawBottom = middle * (MARKER_RATIO_BOTTOM / MARKER_RATIO_MIDDLE);
        const ratioTop = baseMiddle * (MARKER_RATIO_TOP / MARKER_RATIO_MIDDLE);
        const rawTop = Chart.roundTopValue(Math.max(ratioTop, cdbYield24));

        const markers = Chart.ensureDistinct(rawTop, middle, rawBottom);
        markers.scaleMiddle = baseMiddle;
        markers.scaleTop = Math.max(markers.top, cdbYield24);

        return markers;
    },

    formatMarkerNumber: (n, maxDecimals) => {
        const factor = Math.pow(10, maxDecimals);
        const rounded = Math.round(n * factor) / factor;

        return rounded.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {
            minimumFractionDigits: 0,
            maximumFractionDigits: maxDecimals
        });
    },

    formatMarker: (value) => {
        if (value === 0) return 'R$ 0';

        if (value >= 1_000_000) {
            return `R$ ${Chart.formatMarkerNumber(value / 1_000_000, 1)}M`;
        }

        if (value >= 1000) {
            return `R$ ${Chart.formatMarkerNumber(value / 1000, 1)}K`;
        }

        if (value < 1) {
            return `R$ ${Chart.formatMarkerNumber(value, 2)}`;
        }

        return `R$ ${Chart.formatMarkerNumber(value, 0)}`;
    },

    getBarHeightPercent: (yieldValue, markers) => {
        const scaleMiddle = markers.scaleMiddle;
        const scaleTop = markers.scaleTop || markers.top;

        if (yieldValue <= 0 || scaleMiddle <= 0 || scaleTop <= scaleMiddle) return 0;

        if (yieldValue <= scaleMiddle) {
            return (yieldValue / scaleMiddle) * CHART_MIDDLE_HEIGHT_PERCENT;
        }

        if (yieldValue >= scaleTop) {
            return CHART_MAX_BAR_HEIGHT;
        }

        const progress = (yieldValue - scaleMiddle) / (scaleTop - scaleMiddle);
        return CHART_MIDDLE_HEIGHT_PERCENT + progress * (CHART_MAX_BAR_HEIGHT - CHART_MIDDLE_HEIGHT_PERCENT);
    }
};

// ============================================================================
// 7. CDB SIMULATOR
// ============================================================================

const CdbSimulator = {
    getPeriodDays: (periodMonths) => {
        const today = new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo' }));
        today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

        const initializationDate = Calendar.getNextBusinessDay(today);
        initializationDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

        let maturityDate = new Date(initializationDate);
        maturityDate.setMonth(maturityDate.getMonth() + periodMonths);
        maturityDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

        let durationInMs = maturityDate - initializationDate;
        let durationInDays = Math.round(durationInMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

        if (durationInDays < CONFIG.MIN_CDB_DAYS) {
            maturityDate = new Date(initializationDate);
            maturityDate.setDate(maturityDate.getDate() + CONFIG.MIN_CDB_DAYS);
            maturityDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        }

        durationInMs = maturityDate - initializationDate;
        durationInDays = Math.round(durationInMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

        if (periodMonths >= 3 && durationInDays === 90) {
            maturityDate.setDate(maturityDate.getDate() + 1);
            maturityDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
        }

        maturityDate = Calendar.getNextBusinessDay(maturityDate);

        durationInMs = maturityDate - initializationDate;
        return Math.round(durationInMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    },

    simulate: (amount, periodMonths, cdiPercentage) => {
        const today = new Date(new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo' }));
        today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

        const initializationDate = Calendar.getNextBusinessDay(today);
        initializationDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

        let yieldStartDate = new Date(initializationDate);
        yieldStartDate.setDate(yieldStartDate.getDate() + 1);
        yieldStartDate.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

        const periodDays = CdbSimulator.getPeriodDays(periodMonths);

        // Count business days forward from yieldStartDate for periodDays
        const businessDays = Calendar.countFutureBusinessDays(yieldStartDate, periodDays);

        // 2. PU Evolution Loop
        let currentPU = CONFIG.INITIAL_PU;
        let totalGrossYield = 0;
        let grossPosition = 0;

        for (let i = 0; i < businessDays; i++) {
            const result = YieldCalculator.calculateDay(
                currentPU,
                amount,
                CONFIG.CDI_RATE_DAILY,
                cdiPercentage
            );
            currentPU = result.newPU;
            totalGrossYield = result.grossYield;
            grossPosition = result.grossPosition;
        }

        // 3. Tax Calculation Order
        // Important: Taxes must be calculated and truncated in the correct order

        // Step 1: Truncate Gross Yield to 2 decimals
        const grossYieldTruncated = Utils.truncateTo2(totalGrossYield);

        // Step 2: Calculate IOF based on period days
        const iofRate = TaxCalculator.getIOFRate(periodDays);
        const iofRaw = grossYieldTruncated * iofRate;

        // Step 3: Truncate IOF to 2 decimals
        const iofTruncated = Utils.truncateTo2(iofRaw);

        // Step 4: Calculate IR Base (Gross Truncated - IOF Truncated)
        const irBase = grossYieldTruncated - iofTruncated;

        // Step 5: Calculate IR
        const irRate = TaxCalculator.getIRRate(periodDays);
        const irRaw = irBase * irRate;

        // Step 6: Truncate IR to 2 decimals
        const irTruncated = Utils.truncateTo2(irRaw);

        // Step 7: Net Yield
        const netYield = grossYieldTruncated - iofTruncated - irTruncated;

        // Step 8: Net Position
        const netPosition = amount + netYield;

        return {
            netPosition,
            grossPosition,
            netYield,
            savingsReturn: 0
        };
    }
};

                    e.preventDefault();
                    handler();
                });
            } else {
                console.warn(`Element with ID '${id}' not found`);
            }
        };

        // Link blocks in Webflow render as <a>; prevent navigation on click
        const bindLinkBlock = (id, handler) => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (!el) {
                console.warn(`Element with ID '${id}' not found`);
                return;
            }

            if (el.tagName === 'A') {
                el.setAttribute('href', '#');
                el.setAttribute('role', 'button');
            }

            el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                handler();
            });
        };

        // Tabs may be plain divs in Webflow, so they need role, focus and keyboard support
        const bindTab = (id, handler) => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (!el) {
                console.warn(`Element with ID '${id}' not found`);
                return;
            }

            if (el.tagName === 'A') el.setAttribute('href', '#');
            el.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
            el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
            if (el.parentElement) el.parentElement.setAttribute('role', 'tablist');

            el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                handler();
            });

            el.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handler();
                }
            });
        };

        bindClick('initialValueMinus', () => UI.cycleValue('initialValue', false));
        bindClick('initialValuePlus', () => UI.cycleValue('initialValue', true));

        bindClick('cdiValueMinus', () => UI.cycleValue('cdi', false));
        bindClick('cdiValuePlus', () => UI.cycleValue('cdi', true));

        bindClick('timeValueMinus', () => UI.cycleMonths(false));
        bindClick('timeValuePlus', () => UI.cycleMonths(true));

        // Term preset link blocks (1, 6, 12, 24 months)
        TERM_PRESETS.forEach((months) => {
            bindLinkBlock(`termBtn${months}`, () => UI.selectTermPreset(months));
        });

        // Mode tabs (scheduled / daily liquidity)
        Object.entries(MODE_TAB_IDS).forEach(([mode, id]) => {
            bindTab(id, () => UI.setMode(mode));
        });

        // Input manual entry with real-time formatting
        const input = document.getElementById('initialValue');
        if (input) {
            input.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
                let rawValue = e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');

                if (rawValue.length === 0) {
                    e.target.value = '1,00';
                    UI.data.initialValue = 1;
                } else if (rawValue.length === 1) {
                    e.target.value = '0,0' + rawValue;
                    UI.data.initialValue = parseFloat('0.0' + rawValue);
                } else if (rawValue.length === 2) {
                    e.target.value = '0,' + rawValue;
                    UI.data.initialValue = parseFloat('0.' + rawValue);
                } else {
                    let integerPart = rawValue.slice(0, -2);
                    let decimalPart = rawValue.slice(-2);
                    integerPart = parseInt(integerPart, 10).toLocaleString('pt-BR');
                    e.target.value = `${integerPart},${decimalPart}`;
                    UI.data.initialValue = parseFloat(rawValue.slice(0, -2) + '.' + decimalPart);
                }

                // Limit to 250.000,00
                if (parseInt(rawValue, 10) > 25000000) {
                    e.target.value = '250.000,00';
                    UI.data.initialValue = 250000;
                }

                UI.clampInitialValueOnInput();
                UI.updateBoundaryControls();
                UI.updateCalculation();
            });

            input.addEventListener('blur', function (e) {
                let val = Utils.parseCurrency(e.target.value);

                if (!val || val < 1) {
                    UI.data.initialValue = 1;
                    e.target.value = Utils.formatCurrency(1);
                } else {
                    val = UI.findClosest(val, UI.data.initialValuesArray);
                    UI.data.initialValue = Math.max(1, val);
                    e.target.value = Utils.formatCurrency(UI.data.initialValue);
                }

                UI.updateBoundaryControls();
                UI.updateCalculation();
            });

            input.addEventListener('keypress', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                    e.target.blur();
                }
            });
        } else {
            console.warn("Element with ID 'initialValue' not found");
        }
    },

    selectTermPreset: (months) => {
        UI.setMonths(months);
        UI.updateDisplay();
        UI.updateCalculation();
    },

    cycleMonths: (increment) => {
        const arr = UI.data.timeValuesArray;
        let idx = arr.indexOf(UI.data.months);
        if (idx === -1) idx = 0;

        if (increment) {
            if (idx < arr.length - 1) idx++;
        } else {
            if (idx > 0) idx--;
        }

        UI.setMonths(arr[idx]);
        UI.updateDisplay();
        UI.updateCalculation();
    },

    cycleValue: (key, increment) => {
        const arr = key === 'initialValue' ? UI.data.initialValuesArray :
            key === 'cdi' ? UI.data.cdiValuesArray :
                UI.data.timeValuesArray;

        let current = UI.data[key];
        let idx = arr.indexOf(current);

        if (idx === -1) idx = 0;

        if (increment) {
            if (idx < arr.length - 1) idx++;
        } else {
            if (idx > 0) idx--;
        }

        UI.data[key] = arr[idx];
        if (key === 'initialValue') UI.clampInitialValue();
        UI.updateDisplay();
        UI.updateCalculation();
    },

    findClosest: (val, arr) => {
        return arr.reduce((prev, curr) => {
            return (Math.abs(curr - val) < Math.abs(prev - val) ? curr : prev);
        });
    },

    updateTabs: () => {
        Object.entries(MODE_TAB_IDS).forEach(([mode, id]) => {
            const tab = document.getElementById(id);
            if (!tab) return;

            const isSelected = UI.data.mode === mode;
            tab.classList.toggle('is-selected', isSelected);
            tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', isSelected ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
    },

    // Webflow custom attributes:
    // data-cdb-show="scheduled|daily" shows the element only in that mode;
    // data-cdb-text-scheduled / data-cdb-text-daily swap the element's text.
    updateModeContent: () => {
        const mode = UI.data.mode;

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-cdb-show]').forEach((el) => {
            el.style.display = el.getAttribute('data-cdb-show') === mode ? '' : 'none';
        });

        document.querySelectorAll(`[data-cdb-text-${mode}]`).forEach((el) => {
            el.textContent = el.getAttribute(`data-cdb-text-${mode}`);
        });

        TERM_PRESETS.forEach((months) => {
            UI.setText(`termRate${months}`, `${Utils.formatRate(UI.getCdiForMonths(months))}%`);
        });
    },

    updateTermPresets: () => {
        TERM_PRESETS.forEach((months) => {
            const link = document.getElementById(`termBtn${months}`);
            if (!link) return;

            const isSelected = UI.data.months === months;
            link.classList.toggle('is-selected', isSelected);

            if (isSelected) {
                link.setAttribute('aria-current', 'true');
            } else {
                link.removeAttribute('aria-current');
            }
        });
    },

    // "Maior rendimento" only applies while the 111,11% tier is active
    updateLongTermTexts: () => {
        const show = UI.data.cdi === CDI_RATE_FROM_1_YEAR;

        if (show === UI.data.longTermTextsVisible) return;

        UI.data.longTermTextsVisible = show;

        if (show) {
            UI.showTermLongText1();
            UI.showTermLongText2();
        } else {
            UI.hideTermLongText1();
            UI.hideTermLongText2();
        }
    },

    updateDisplay: () => {
        // Initial Value
        const initialValueEl = document.getElementById('initialValue');
        if (initialValueEl) {
            initialValueEl.value = Utils.formatCurrency(UI.data.initialValue);
            initialValueEl.setAttribute('data-raw-value', UI.data.initialValue);
        }

        // CDI
        const cdiValueEl = document.getElementById('cdiValue');
        if (cdiValueEl) {
            cdiValueEl.textContent = `${Utils.formatCurrency(UI.data.cdi)} %`;
            cdiValueEl.setAttribute('data-raw-value', UI.data.cdi);
        }

        // Time
        const label = UI.data.months === 1 ? 'mês' : 'meses';
        const timeValueEl = document.getElementById('timeValue');
        if (timeValueEl) {
            timeValueEl.textContent = `${UI.data.months} ${label}`;
            timeValueEl.setAttribute('data-raw-value', UI.data.months);
        }

        const resultLabel = document.getElementById('monthsValueResult');
        if (resultLabel) resultLabel.textContent = `${UI.data.months} ${label}`;

        UI.updateTabs();
        UI.updateModeContent();
        UI.updateTermPresets();
        UI.updateLongTermTexts();
        UI.updateBoundaryControls();
    },

    updateBoundaryControls: () => {
        const timeMinusBtn = document.getElementById('timeValueMinus');
        const timePlusBtn = document.getElementById('timeValuePlus');
        const initialMinusBtn = document.getElementById('initialValueMinus');

        if (timeMinusBtn) {
            timeMinusBtn.style.opacity = UI.data.months <= 1 ? '0' : '';
            timeMinusBtn.style.pointerEvents = UI.data.months <= 1 ? 'none' : '';
        }
        if (timePlusBtn) {
            timePlusBtn.style.opacity = UI.data.months >= 24 ? '0' : '';
            timePlusBtn.style.pointerEvents = UI.data.months >= 24 ? 'none' : '';
        }
        if (initialMinusBtn) {
            initialMinusBtn.style.opacity = UI.data.initialValue <= 1 ? '0' : '';
            initialMinusBtn.style.pointerEvents = UI.data.initialValue <= 1 ? 'none' : '';
        }

        // Daily liquidity has a fixed rate, so manual CDI adjustment is disabled
        const cdiLocked = UI.data.mode === MODE_DAILY;
        ['cdiValueMinus', 'cdiValuePlus'].forEach((id) => {
            const btn = document.getElementById(id);
            if (!btn) return;
            btn.style.opacity = cdiLocked ? '0' : '';
            btn.style.pointerEvents = cdiLocked ? 'none' : '';
        });
    },

    clampInitialValue: () => {
        if (UI.data.initialValue < 1) {
            UI.data.initialValue = 1;
        }
    },

    clampInitialValueOnInput: () => {
        if (UI.data.initialValue <= 0) {
            UI.data.initialValue = 1;
        }
    },

    updateCalculation: () => {
        const principal = UI.data.initialValue;
        const months = UI.data.months;
        const cdi = UI.data.cdi;

        const cdbResult = CdbSimulator.simulate(principal, months, cdi);
        const cdi100Result = CdbSimulator.simulate(principal, months, 100);
        const savings = principal * Math.pow(1 + CONFIG.SAVINGS_MONTHLY_RATE, months);

        const savingsYield = savings - principal;

        UI.setText('initialValueMirror', `R$ ${Utils.formatCurrency(principal)}`);
        UI.setText('cdiValueMirror', `${Utils.formatRate(cdi)}%`);
        UI.setText('savingsYieldResult', Utils.formatYield(savingsYield));
        UI.setText('cdi100YieldResult', Utils.formatYield(cdi100Result.netYield));
        UI.setText('cdbYieldResult', Utils.formatYield(cdbResult.netYield));
        UI.setText('savingsCdbIpDiffResult', Utils.formatYield(cdbResult.netYield - savingsYield));

        UI.updateChart(principal, savingsYield, cdi100Result.netYield, cdbResult.netYield);

        const grossValueEl = document.getElementById('grossValue');
        if (grossValueEl) {
            grossValueEl.textContent = Utils.formatCurrency(cdbResult.netPosition);
        }

        const savingsResultEl = document.getElementById('savingsResult');
        if (savingsResultEl) {
            savingsResultEl.textContent = `R$ ${Utils.formatCurrency(savings)}`;
        }

        const diff = cdbResult.netPosition - savings;
        const diffEl = document.getElementById('differenceResult');
        if (diffEl) {
            diffEl.textContent = (diff >= 0 ? '' : '-') + `R$ ${Utils.formatCurrency(Math.abs(diff))}`;
        }
    },

    setText: (id, text) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.textContent = text;
    },

    setBarHeight: (id, percent) => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el) el.style.height = `${percent}%`;
    },

    updateChart: (initialValue, savingsYield, cdi100Yield, cdbYield) => {
        const markers = Chart.getMarkers(initialValue);

        UI.setText('chartMarkerTop', Chart.formatMarker(markers.top));
        UI.setText('chartMarkerMiddle', Chart.formatMarker(markers.middle));
        UI.setText('chartMarkerBottom', Chart.formatMarker(markers.bottom));
        UI.setText('chartMarkerZero', Chart.formatMarker(0));

        UI.setBarHeight('chartBarSavings', Chart.getBarHeightPercent(savingsYield, markers));
        UI.setBarHeight('chartBarCdi100', Chart.getBarHeightPercent(cdi100Yield, markers));
        UI.setBarHeight('chartBarCdb', Chart.getBarHeightPercent(cdbYield, markers));
    }
};

// Start — busca CDI do BCB antes de inicializar a UI
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
    await CdiRateProvider.fetchLatest();
    UI.init();
});

(function() {
    'use strict';
    
    function preventEnter(e) {
        if ((e.key === 'Enter' || e.keyCode === 13) && ['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT'].includes(e.target.tagName)) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            e.stopImmediatePropagation();
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    function init(form) {
        if (!form || form.tagName !== 'FORM') return;
        
        // Use capture phase to catch events before other handlers
        form.addEventListener('keydown', preventEnter, true);
        form.addEventListener('keypress', preventEnter, true);
        
        form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            return false;
        }, true);
    }
    
    function initAll() {
        // Find forms with attribute directly OR forms inside elements with the attribute
        const forms1 = document.querySelectorAll('form[data-form="prevent-default"]');
        const forms2 = document.querySelectorAll('[data-form="prevent-default"] form');
        const allForms = new Set([...forms1, ...forms2]);
        allForms.forEach(init);
    }
    
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initAll);
    } else {
        initAll();
    }
    
    window.preventFormSubmit = function(selector) {
        const form = typeof selector === 'string' ? (document.getElementById(selector) || document.querySelector(selector)) : selector;
        init(form);
    };
})();
</script>
