<script>
  /* FAQPage schema: lê as perguntas do componente e gera um único JSON-LD por página. */
  (function () {
    var SRC = {"item":"[data-faq] .faq1_item","q":[".faq1_item_q",".faq1_item_trigger"],"a":[".faq1_item_answer"]};
    var reg = window.__faqSchema || (window.__faqSchema = { sources: [], scheduled: false });
    for (var i = 0; i < reg.sources.length; i++) if (reg.sources[i].item === SRC.item) return;
    reg.sources.push(SRC);
    if (reg.scheduled) return;
    reg.scheduled = true;

    function hasFaqPage() {
      return Array.prototype.some.call(document.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]'), function (s) {
        return /"FAQPage"/.test(s.textContent);
      });
    }

    function clean(t) {
      return (t || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    }

    function text(el) {
      var c = el.cloneNode(true);
      Array.prototype.forEach.call(c.querySelectorAll('br'), function (b) {
        b.parentNode.replaceChild(document.createTextNode(' '), b);
      });
      return clean(c.textContent);
    }

    function first(item, sels) {
      for (var i = 0; i < sels.length; i++) {
        var el = item.querySelector(sels[i]);
        if (el) return el;
      }
      return null;
    }

    function answerText(a) {
      var blocks = Array.prototype.filter.call(a.querySelectorAll('p, li, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, blockquote'), function (b) {
        return !b.querySelector('p, li');
      });
      if (!blocks.length) return text(a);
      return blocks.map(text).filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    }

    function build() {
      if (hasFaqPage()) return;
      var mainEntity = [];
      var seen = {};
      reg.sources.forEach(function (src) {
        Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(src.item), function (item) {
          var q = first(item, src.q);
          var a = first(item, src.a);
          if (!q || !a) return;
          var question = text(q);
          var answer = answerText(a);
          if (!question || !answer || seen[question]) return;
          seen[question] = true;
          mainEntity.push({
            '@type': 'Question',
            name: question,
            acceptedAnswer: { '@type': 'Answer', text: answer },
          });
        });
      });
      if (!mainEntity.length) return;
      var canonical = document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]');
      var base = canonical && canonical.href ? canonical.href : location.href.split('#')[0];
      var s = document.createElement('script');
      s.type = 'application/ld+json';
      s.setAttribute('data-faq-schema', '');
      s.textContent = JSON.stringify({
        '@context': 'https://schema.org',
        '@type': 'FAQPage',
        '@id': base.split('#')[0] + '#faq',
        inLanguage: document.documentElement.lang || 'pt-BR',
        mainEntity: mainEntity,
      });
      document.head.appendChild(s);
    }

    /* setTimeout: roda depois dos outros handlers de DOMContentLoaded (scripts antigos de FAQ), para a trava pegar o FAQPage deles. */
    var run = function () {

    };

    else run();
  })();

<script>
  const API_CONFIG = {
    url: "https://infinitepay-communication-api.services.production.infinitepay.io/comm/api/whatsapp-widget/clicks",
  };

  const PHONE_NUMBER = "5511953255030";

  const DEFAULT_MESSAGE =
    "Olá, estou interessado em saber mais sobre a InfinitePay";

  const API_TIMEOUT_MS = 2000;

  function getWhatsappRedirectParams() {
    const anonId =
      typeof window?.rudderanalytics?.getAnonymousId === "function"
        ? window.rudderanalytics.getAnonymousId()
        : "anonymous";

    const href = window.location.href.split("?")[0] || "";

    let utmParams = {};
    try {
      const cookieString = document.cookie
        .split(";")
        .find((c) => c.trim().startsWith("ifp_search_params="));

      if (cookieString) {
        const cookieValue = cookieString.split("=")[1];
        if (cookieValue) {
          utmParams = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(cookieValue));
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("Error parsing UTM params from cookie:", err);
    }

    return { anonId, href, utmParams };
  }

  function trackWhatsappEvent(action, extras = {}) {
    if (window?.rudderanalytics) {
      window.rudderanalytics.track("WhatsApp Conversation", {
        action,
        phone_number: PHONE_NUMBER,
        ...extras,
      });
    }
  }

  async function getWhatsappUrl(message = DEFAULT_MESSAGE) {
    const { anonId, href, utmParams } = getWhatsappRedirectParams();

    try {
      const response = await Promise.race([
        fetch(API_CONFIG.url, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            anon_id: anonId,
            href,
            ifb_params: utmParams,
            message,
          }),
        }),
        new Promise((_, reject) =>
          setTimeout(() => reject(new Error("Timeout")), API_TIMEOUT_MS)
        ),
      ]);

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
      }

      const data = await response.json();

      trackWhatsappEvent("clicked", {
        href,
        chat_id: data.chat_id,
        ifb_params: utmParams,
      });

      return data.redirect_url;
    } catch (error) {
      trackWhatsappEvent("error", {
        href,
        chat_id: null,
        ifb_params: utmParams,
        error: error.message,
      });

      console.error("Error generating WhatsApp URL:", error);
      return `https://wa.me/${PHONE_NUMBER}?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`;
    }
  }

  function isMobileOrSafari() {
    const ua = navigator.userAgent;
    if (/Android|webOS|iPhone|iPad|iPod|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini/i.test(ua)) {
      return true;
    }
    return /Safari/i.test(ua) && !/Chrome/i.test(ua);
  }

  function initWhatsappWidget() {
    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll("#whatsapp-button");
    if (!buttons.length) return;

    buttons.forEach((button) => {
      let pending = false;

      button.addEventListener("click", async (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (pending) return;
        pending = true;

        const container = button.closest(".whatsapp-container");
        container?.classList.add("loading");

        const newTab = isMobileOrSafari() ? null : window.open("", "_blank");

        try {
          const message =
            button.getAttribute("data-message") || DEFAULT_MESSAGE;
          const url = await getWhatsappUrl(message);

          if (newTab && !newTab.closed) {
            newTab.opener = null;
            newTab.location.href = url;
          } else {
            window.location.href = url;
          }
        } catch {
          if (newTab && !newTab.closed) newTab.close();
        } finally {
          container?.classList.remove("loading");
          pending = false;
        }
      });
    });
  }

<script async>
(function(){
var second = 1000,
    minute = second * 60,
    hour = minute * 60,
    day = hour * 24;

function getNextSunday(date) {
    var dayOfWeek = date.getDay();
    var daysToNextSunday = (7 - dayOfWeek) % 7 || 7;

    var nextSunday = new Date(date);
    nextSunday.setDate(date.getDate() + daysToNextSunday);
    nextSunday.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999)

    return nextSunday;
}

var countDown = getNextSunday(new Date()).getTime(),
    x = setInterval(function() {

        var now = new Date().getTime(),
            distance = countDown - now;

        if (distance < 0) {
            countDown = getNextSunday(new Date()).getTime()
        }

        var daysElem = document.getElementById('days');
        var hoursElem = document.getElementById('hours');
        var minutesElem = document.getElementById('minutes');
        var secondsElem = document.getElementById('seconds');

        if (!daysElem || !hoursElem || !minutesElem || !secondsElem) {
            return;
        }

        daysElem.innerText = Math.floor(distance / (day));
        hoursElem.innerText = Math.floor((distance % (day)) / (hour));
        minutesElem.innerText = Math.floor((distance % (hour)) / (minute));
        secondsElem.innerText = Math.floor((distance % (minute)) / second);

    }, second);
})();
</script>

<script>
(() => {
    const WHITELIST = new Set([
        "utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign", "utm_content", "utm_term", "utm_name",
        "gclid", "fbclid", "click_id", "ttclid"
    ]);

    const STORAGE = window.sessionStorage;
    const KEY = "ifp_persist_query_params";

    const pickParams = (sp) => {
        const out = new URLSearchParams();
        for (const [k, v] of sp.entries()) {
            if (WHITELIST.has(k) && v) out.set(k, v);
        }
        return out;
    };

    const currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
    const incomingPicked = pickParams(currentUrl.searchParams);

    if ([...incomingPicked.keys()].length) {
        STORAGE.setItem(KEY, incomingPicked.toString());
    }

    const storedStr = STORAGE.getItem(KEY) || "";
    if (!storedStr) return;

    const stored = new URLSearchParams(storedStr);

    // Replacestate pra manter UTMs na URL se user copiar link
    let changed = false;
    for (const [k, v] of stored.entries()) {
        if (!currentUrl.searchParams.has(k)) {
            currentUrl.searchParams.set(k, v);
            changed = true;
        }
    }
    if (changed) {
        history.replaceState({}, "", currentUrl.pathname + "?" + currentUrl.searchParams.toString() + currentUrl.hash);
    }

    // Aceita links internos E cross-subdomain (.infinitepay.io)
    const isOwnLink = (a) => {
        const href = a.getAttribute("href") || "";
        if (!href || href.startsWith("#") || href.startsWith("mailto:") || href.startsWith("tel:") || href.startsWith("javascript:")) return false;
        try {
            const u = new URL(href, window.location.origin);
            return u.hostname.endsWith(".infinitepay.io") || u.origin === window.location.origin;
        } catch { return false; }
    };

    const withStoredParams = (href) => {
        const u = new URL(href, window.location.origin);
        for (const [k, v] of stored.entries()) {
            if (!u.searchParams.has(k)) u.searchParams.set(k, v);
        }
        return u.toString();
    };

    const updateAllLinks = () => {
        document.querySelectorAll("a[href]").forEach(a => {
            if (!isOwnLink(a)) return;
            a.setAttribute("href", withStoredParams(a.getAttribute("href")));
        });
    };

    // Catch clicks dinâmicos (CMS, scripts que inserem links depois)
    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("a[href]");
        if (!a || !isOwnLink(a)) return;
        a.setAttribute("href", withStoredParams(a.getAttribute("href")));
    }, true);

    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", updateAllLinks);
    } else {
        updateAllLinks();
    }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var hasSourceApp = params.get('source') === 'app';
  var isInfinitePayUA = /InfinitePayApp/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
  var storageKey = 'force_source_app';

  if (hasSourceApp || isInfinitePayUA) {
    sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey, '1');
  }

  var shouldForceApp = sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey) === '1';

  if (!shouldForceApp) return;

  document.documentElement.classList.add('is-webview');

  if (params.get('source') !== 'app') {
    params.set('source', 'app');
    var newUrl =
      window.location.pathname +
      '?' +
      params.toString() +
      window.location.hash;
    history.replaceState(null, '', newUrl);
  }

  function patchLink(a) {
    var href = a.getAttribute('href');
    if (!href || href.startsWith('#') || href.startsWith('javascript:')) return;

    var url = new URL(href, window.location.origin);
    if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return;

    url.searchParams.set('source', 'app');
    a.setAttribute('href', url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(patchLink);

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href]');
    if (a) patchLink(a);
  }, true);

  document.querySelectorAll('form[method="get"]').forEach(function (form) {
    var action = form.getAttribute('action') || window.location.pathname;
    var url = new URL(action, window.location.origin);
    if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return;

    var input = form.querySelector('input[name="source"]');
    if (!input) {
      input = document.createElement('input');
      input.type = 'hidden';
      input.name = 'source';
      form.appendChild(input);
    }
    input.value = 'app';
  });
})();

<script>
gsap.registerPlugin(CustomEase, ScrollTrigger, Draggable, InertiaPlugin)

CustomEase.create("osmo-ease", "0.625, 0.05, 0, 1")

// Constantes de animação reutilizáveis
const ANIM_CONFIG = {
  scale: { duration: 0.8, ease: "osmo-ease" },
  nav: { ease: "osmo-ease", duration: 0.725 },
  init: { duration: 0.01 }
};

function initSliders() {
  const sliderWrappers = gsap.utils.toArray(document.querySelectorAll('[data-centered-slider="wrapper"]'));

  sliderWrappers.forEach((sliderWrapper) => {
    const slides = gsap.utils.toArray(sliderWrapper.querySelectorAll('[data-centered-slider="slide"]'));
    const bullets = gsap.utils.toArray(sliderWrapper.querySelectorAll('[data-centered-slider="bullet"]'));
    const prevButton = sliderWrapper.querySelector('[data-centered-slider="prev-button"]');
    const nextButton = sliderWrapper.querySelector('[data-centered-slider="next-button"]');
    const slidesLength = slides.length;

    let activeElement;
    let activeBullet;
    let currentIndex = 0;
    let autoplay;
    let scaleTweens = {}; // Cache de tweens para evitar recriação

    // Autoplay config
    const autoplayEnabled = sliderWrapper.getAttribute('data-slider-autoplay') === 'true';
    const autoplayDuration = autoplayEnabled ? parseFloat(sliderWrapper.getAttribute('data-slider-autoplay-duration')) || 4 : 0;

    // Inicialização batch: IDs e ARIA attributes
    slides.forEach((slide, i) => {
      slide.id = `slide-${i}`;
    });
    
    if (bullets.length) {
      bullets.forEach((bullet, i) => {
        bullet.setAttribute("aria-controls", `slide-${i}`);
      });
    }

    // Função otimizada para atualizar scale dos slides
    const updateSlidesScale = (activeIndex) => {
      const activeSlide = slides[activeIndex];
      const inactiveSlides = slides.filter((_, i) => i !== activeIndex);
      
      // Kill tweens existentes para evitar conflitos
      if (scaleTweens.active) scaleTweens.active.kill();
      if (scaleTweens.inactive) scaleTweens.inactive.kill();
      
      // Batch animation: ativo e inativos em paralelo
      scaleTweens.active = gsap.to(activeSlide, { 
        scale: 1, 
        opacity: 1, 
        ...ANIM_CONFIG.scale 
      });
      
      if (inactiveSlides.length) {
        scaleTweens.inactive = gsap.to(inactiveSlides, { 
          scale: 0.9, 
          opacity: 1, 
          ...ANIM_CONFIG.scale 
        });
      }
      
      // Atualizar classes (mais rápido que animação)
      activeSlide.classList.add("active");
      inactiveSlides.forEach(slide => slide.classList.remove("active"));
    };

    // Função otimizada para atualizar bullets
    const updateBullets = (index) => {
      if (!bullets.length) return;
      
      const newBullet = bullets[index];
      if (activeBullet && activeBullet !== newBullet) {
        activeBullet.classList.remove("active");
        activeBullet.setAttribute("aria-selected", "false");
      }
      if (newBullet) {
        newBullet.classList.add("active");
        newBullet.setAttribute("aria-selected", "true");
        activeBullet = newBullet;
      }
    };

    const loop = horizontalLoop(slides, {
      paused: true,
      draggable: true,
      center: true,
      onChange: (element, index) => {
        currentIndex = index;
        updateSlidesScale(index);
        activeElement = element;
        updateBullets(index);
      }
    });
    
    // Inicialização
    const initIndex = 2;
    loop.toIndex(initIndex, ANIM_CONFIG.init);
    currentIndex = initIndex;
    
    // Batch initialization dos slides
    const initActive = slides[initIndex];
    const initInactive = slides.filter((_, i) => i !== initIndex);
    
    gsap.set(initActive, { scale: 1, opacity: 1 });
    initActive.classList.add("active");
    activeElement = initActive;
    
    if (initInactive.length) {
      gsap.set(initInactive, { scale: 0.9, opacity: 1 });
      initInactive.forEach(slide => slide.classList.remove("active"));
    }
    
    if (bullets.length) {
      updateBullets(initIndex);
    }

    // Autoplay otimizado
    const startAutoplay = () => {
      if (autoplayDuration > 0 && !autoplay) {
        const repeat = () => {
          loop.next(ANIM_CONFIG.nav);
          autoplay = gsap.delayedCall(autoplayDuration, repeat);
        };
        autoplay = gsap.delayedCall(autoplayDuration, repeat);
      }
    };

    const stopAutoplay = () => {
      if (autoplay) {
        autoplay.kill();
        autoplay = null;
      }
    };

    // ScrollTrigger para autoplay
    ScrollTrigger.create({
      trigger: sliderWrapper,
      start: "top bottom",
      end: "bottom top",
      onEnter: startAutoplay,
      onLeave: stopAutoplay,
      onEnterBack: startAutoplay,
      onLeaveBack: stopAutoplay
    });

    // Event delegation para hover (mais eficiente)
    sliderWrapper.addEventListener("mouseenter", stopAutoplay, { passive: true });
    sliderWrapper.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
      if (ScrollTrigger.isInViewport(sliderWrapper)) startAutoplay();
    }, { passive: true });

    // Event delegation para slides (mais eficiente que múltiplos listeners)
    sliderWrapper.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const slide = e.target.closest('[data-centered-slider="slide"]');
      if (slide) {
        const index = slides.indexOf(slide);
        if (index !== -1 && index !== currentIndex) {
          loop.toIndex(index, ANIM_CONFIG.nav);
        }
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    // Event delegation para bullets
    if (bullets.length) {
      sliderWrapper.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const bullet = e.target.closest('[data-centered-slider="bullet"]');
        if (bullet) {
          const index = bullets.indexOf(bullet);
          if (index !== -1 && index !== currentIndex) {
            loop.toIndex(index, ANIM_CONFIG.nav);
          }
        }
      }, { passive: true });
    }

    // Prev/Next buttons otimizados
    if (prevButton) {
      prevButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const newIndex = currentIndex > 0 ? currentIndex - 1 : slidesLength - 1;
        loop.toIndex(newIndex, ANIM_CONFIG.nav);
      }, { passive: true });
    }

    if (nextButton) {
      nextButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const newIndex = currentIndex < slidesLength - 1 ? currentIndex + 1 : 0;
        loop.toIndex(newIndex, ANIM_CONFIG.nav);
      }, { passive: true });
    }
    
  });
}

// GSAP Helper function to create a looping slider

function horizontalLoop(items, config) {

<script>
    (function () {
        "use strict";

        var COOKIE_NAME = "_exp_ctx";

        // Get cookie value
        var getCookie = function (name) {
            var needle = name + "=";
            var hit = document.cookie.split("; ").find(function (c) { return c.startsWith(needle); });
            return hit ? hit.slice(needle.length) : null;
        };

        // Delete cookie
        var deleteCookie = function (name, domain) {
            document.cookie = name + "=; Path=/; Domain=" + domain + "; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0";
        };

        // Get domain for cookie (e.g., ".jim.com")
        var getCookieDomain = function () {
            var host = window.location.hostname;
            if (host.startsWith("www.")) host = host.slice(4);
            return "." + host;
        };

        try {
            var raw = getCookie(COOKIE_NAME);
            if (!raw) return; // No backup cookie, nothing to do

            var params = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(raw));
            if (!params || typeof params !== "object") return;

            var url = new URL(window.location.href);
            var changed = false;

            // Only restore params that are missing from current URL
            for (var key in params) {
                if (params.hasOwnProperty(key) && !url.searchParams.has(key)) {
                    url.searchParams.set(key, params[key]);

                }
            }

                window.history.replaceState(null, "", url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
            }

            // Always delete the cookie after reading (one-time use)

        } catch (e) {
            // Silently fail - don't break the page
        }
    })();

                    exp_device_id: expDeviceId,

                }));

                            expDeviceId: expDeviceId,

    function injectQrFallback(el) {

        if (hasRenderedQr(el)) return;

    function ensureQrFallbacks() {

    function scheduleFallbackChecks() {
        FALLBACK_CHECK_DELAYS.forEach(function (delay) {
            setTimeout(ensureQrFallbacks, delay);
        });

    function renderQr(el, config, expectedURL) {
        if (!el || !expectedURL) return;
        if (el.getAttribute("data-af-qr-url") === expectedURL && hasRenderedQr(el)) return;

        var again = window.AF_SMART_SCRIPT.generateOneLinkURL(config);

        el.innerHTML = "";

        window.AF_SMART_SCRIPT.displayQrCode(el.id, { codeColor: "#000000" });
        el.setAttribute("data-af-qr-url", expectedURL);

    function applyKey(key, anonId) {

        var result = window.AF_SMART_SCRIPT.generateOneLinkURL(config);

            applyAll(appliedAnonId || anonId);

                });

        }, applyFallback);
    });

<script async>
(function(){
var second = 1000,
    minute = second * 60,
    hour = minute * 60,
    day = hour * 24;

function getNextSunday(date) {
    var dayOfWeek = date.getDay();
    var daysToNextSunday = (7 - dayOfWeek) % 7 || 7;

    var nextSunday = new Date(date);
    nextSunday.setDate(date.getDate() + daysToNextSunday);
    nextSunday.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999)

    return nextSunday;
}

var countDown = getNextSunday(new Date()).getTime(),
    x = setInterval(function() {

        var now = new Date().getTime(),
            distance = countDown - now;

        if (distance < 0) {
            countDown = getNextSunday(new Date()).getTime()
        }

        var daysElem = document.getElementById('days');
        var hoursElem = document.getElementById('hours');
        var minutesElem = document.getElementById('minutes');
        var secondsElem = document.getElementById('seconds');

        if (!daysElem || !hoursElem || !minutesElem || !secondsElem) {
            return;
        }

        daysElem.innerText = Math.floor(distance / (day));
        hoursElem.innerText = Math.floor((distance % (day)) / (hour));
        minutesElem.innerText = Math.floor((distance % (hour)) / (minute));
        secondsElem.innerText = Math.floor((distance % (minute)) / second);

    }, second);
})();
</script>

<script>
(() => {
    const WHITELIST = new Set([
        "utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign", "utm_content", "utm_term", "utm_name",
        "gclid", "fbclid", "click_id", "ttclid"
    ]);

    const STORAGE = window.sessionStorage;
    const KEY = "ifp_persist_query_params";

    const pickParams = (sp) => {
        const out = new URLSearchParams();
        for (const [k, v] of sp.entries()) {
            if (WHITELIST.has(k) && v) out.set(k, v);
        }
        return out;
    };

    const currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
    const incomingPicked = pickParams(currentUrl.searchParams);

    if ([...incomingPicked.keys()].length) {
        STORAGE.setItem(KEY, incomingPicked.toString());
    }

    const storedStr = STORAGE.getItem(KEY) || "";
    if (!storedStr) return;

    const stored = new URLSearchParams(storedStr);

    // Replacestate pra manter UTMs na URL se user copiar link
    let changed = false;
    for (const [k, v] of stored.entries()) {
        if (!currentUrl.searchParams.has(k)) {
            currentUrl.searchParams.set(k, v);
            changed = true;
        }
    }
    if (changed) {
        history.replaceState({}, "", currentUrl.pathname + "?" + currentUrl.searchParams.toString() + currentUrl.hash);
    }

    // Aceita links internos E cross-subdomain (.infinitepay.io)
    const isOwnLink = (a) => {
        const href = a.getAttribute("href") || "";
        if (!href || href.startsWith("#") || href.startsWith("mailto:") || href.startsWith("tel:") || href.startsWith("javascript:")) return false;
        try {
            const u = new URL(href, window.location.origin);
            return u.hostname.endsWith(".infinitepay.io") || u.origin === window.location.origin;
        } catch { return false; }
    };

    const withStoredParams = (href) => {
        const u = new URL(href, window.location.origin);
        for (const [k, v] of stored.entries()) {
            if (!u.searchParams.has(k)) u.searchParams.set(k, v);
        }
        return u.toString();
    };

    const updateAllLinks = () => {
        document.querySelectorAll("a[href]").forEach(a => {
            if (!isOwnLink(a)) return;
            a.setAttribute("href", withStoredParams(a.getAttribute("href")));
        });
    };

    // Catch clicks dinâmicos (CMS, scripts que inserem links depois)
    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("a[href]");
        if (!a || !isOwnLink(a)) return;
        a.setAttribute("href", withStoredParams(a.getAttribute("href")));
    }, true);

    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", updateAllLinks);
    } else {
        updateAllLinks();
    }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var hasSourceApp = params.get('source') === 'app';
  var isInfinitePayUA = /InfinitePayApp/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
  var storageKey = 'force_source_app';

  if (hasSourceApp || isInfinitePayUA) {
    sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey, '1');
  }

  var shouldForceApp = sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey) === '1';

  if (!shouldForceApp) return;

  document.documentElement.classList.add('is-webview');

  if (params.get('source') !== 'app') {
    params.set('source', 'app');
    var newUrl =
      window.location.pathname +
      '?' +
      params.toString() +
      window.location.hash;
    history.replaceState(null, '', newUrl);
  }

  function patchLink(a) {
    var href = a.getAttribute('href');
    if (!href || href.startsWith('#') || href.startsWith('javascript:')) return;

    var url = new URL(href, window.location.origin);
    if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return;

    url.searchParams.set('source', 'app');
    a.setAttribute('href', url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(patchLink);

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href]');
    if (a) patchLink(a);
  }, true);

  document.querySelectorAll('form[method="get"]').forEach(function (form) {
    var action = form.getAttribute('action') || window.location.pathname;
    var url = new URL(action, window.location.origin);
    if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return;

    var input = form.querySelector('input[name="source"]');
    if (!input) {
      input = document.createElement('input');
      input.type = 'hidden';
      input.name = 'source';
      form.appendChild(input);
    }
    input.value = 'app';
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
    (function () {
        "use strict";

        var COOKIE_NAME = "_exp_ctx";

        // Get cookie value
        var getCookie = function (name) {
            var needle = name + "=";
            var hit = document.cookie.split("; ").find(function (c) { return c.startsWith(needle); });
            return hit ? hit.slice(needle.length) : null;
        };

        // Delete cookie
        var deleteCookie = function (name, domain) {
            document.cookie = name + "=; Path=/; Domain=" + domain + "; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=0";
        };

        // Get domain for cookie (e.g., ".jim.com")
        var getCookieDomain = function () {
            var host = window.location.hostname;
            if (host.startsWith("www.")) host = host.slice(4);
            return "." + host;
        };

        try {
            var raw = getCookie(COOKIE_NAME);
            if (!raw) return; // No backup cookie, nothing to do

            var params = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(raw));
            if (!params || typeof params !== "object") return;

            var url = new URL(window.location.href);
            var changed = false;

            // Only restore params that are missing from current URL
            for (var key in params) {
                if (params.hasOwnProperty(key) && !url.searchParams.has(key)) {
                    url.searchParams.set(key, params[key]);
                    changed = true;
                }
            }

            // Update URL if we restored any params
            if (changed && window.history && window.history.replaceState) {
                window.history.replaceState(null, "", url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
            }

            // Always delete the cookie after reading (one-time use)
            deleteCookie(COOKIE_NAME, getCookieDomain());

        } catch (e) {
            // Silently fail - don't break the page
        }
    })();

    function injectQrFallback(el) {

        if (hasRenderedQr(el)) return;

        el.innerHTML = "";
        var img = document.createElement("img");

        }

    function ensureQrFallbacks() {

    function scheduleFallbackChecks() {
        FALLBACK_CHECK_DELAYS.forEach(function (delay) {
            setTimeout(ensureQrFallbacks, delay);
        });

    function renderQr(el, config, expectedURL) {
        if (!el || !expectedURL) return;

    });

<script async>
(function(){
var second = 1000,
    minute = second * 60,
    hour = minute * 60,
    day = hour * 24;

function getNextSunday(date) {
    var dayOfWeek = date.getDay();
    var daysToNextSunday = (7 - dayOfWeek) % 7 || 7;

    var nextSunday = new Date(date);
    nextSunday.setDate(date.getDate() + daysToNextSunday);
    nextSunday.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999)

    return nextSunday;
}

var countDown = getNextSunday(new Date()).getTime(),
    x = setInterval(function() {

        var now = new Date().getTime(),
            distance = countDown - now;

        if (distance < 0) {
            countDown = getNextSunday(new Date()).getTime()
        }

        var daysElem = document.getElementById('days');
        var hoursElem = document.getElementById('hours');
        var minutesElem = document.getElementById('minutes');
        var secondsElem = document.getElementById('seconds');

        if (!daysElem || !hoursElem || !minutesElem || !secondsElem) {
            return;
        }

        daysElem.innerText = Math.floor(distance / (day));
        hoursElem.innerText = Math.floor((distance % (day)) / (hour));
        minutesElem.innerText = Math.floor((distance % (hour)) / (minute));
        secondsElem.innerText = Math.floor((distance % (minute)) / second);

    }, second);
})();
</script>

<script>
(() => {
    const WHITELIST = new Set([
        "utm_source", "utm_medium", "utm_campaign", "utm_content", "utm_term", "utm_name",
        "gclid", "fbclid", "click_id", "ttclid"
    ]);

    const STORAGE = window.sessionStorage;
    const KEY = "ifp_persist_query_params";

    const pickParams = (sp) => {
        const out = new URLSearchParams();
        for (const [k, v] of sp.entries()) {
            if (WHITELIST.has(k) && v) out.set(k, v);
        }
        return out;
    };

    const currentUrl = new URL(window.location.href);
    const incomingPicked = pickParams(currentUrl.searchParams);

    if ([...incomingPicked.keys()].length) {
        STORAGE.setItem(KEY, incomingPicked.toString());
    }

    const storedStr = STORAGE.getItem(KEY) || "";
    if (!storedStr) return;

    const stored = new URLSearchParams(storedStr);

    // Replacestate pra manter UTMs na URL se user copiar link
    let changed = false;
    for (const [k, v] of stored.entries()) {
        if (!currentUrl.searchParams.has(k)) {
            currentUrl.searchParams.set(k, v);
            changed = true;
        }
    }
    if (changed) {
        history.replaceState({}, "", currentUrl.pathname + "?" + currentUrl.searchParams.toString() + currentUrl.hash);
    }

    // Aceita links internos E cross-subdomain (.infinitepay.io)
    const isOwnLink = (a) => {
        const href = a.getAttribute("href") || "";
        if (!href || href.startsWith("#") || href.startsWith("mailto:") || href.startsWith("tel:") || href.startsWith("javascript:")) return false;
        try {
            const u = new URL(href, window.location.origin);
            return u.hostname.endsWith(".infinitepay.io") || u.origin === window.location.origin;
        } catch { return false; }
    };

    const withStoredParams = (href) => {
        const u = new URL(href, window.location.origin);
        for (const [k, v] of stored.entries()) {
            if (!u.searchParams.has(k)) u.searchParams.set(k, v);
        }
        return u.toString();
    };

    const updateAllLinks = () => {
        document.querySelectorAll("a[href]").forEach(a => {
            if (!isOwnLink(a)) return;
            a.setAttribute("href", withStoredParams(a.getAttribute("href")));
        });
    };

    // Catch clicks dinâmicos (CMS, scripts que inserem links depois)
    document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        const a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest("a[href]");
        if (!a || !isOwnLink(a)) return;
        a.setAttribute("href", withStoredParams(a.getAttribute("href")));
    }, true);

    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", updateAllLinks);
    } else {
        updateAllLinks();
    }
})();
</script>

<script>

    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      var f = document.querySelector(
        'footer,[class*="footer_component"],[class*="footer-section"]'
      );
      if (!f) return;
      function clean(el) {
        Array.from(el.children).forEach(function (c) {
          if (
            getComputedStyle(c).display === "none" &&
            c.querySelectorAll("a").length > 3
          ) {
            c.remove();
          }
        });
      }
      clean(f);
      Array.from(f.children).forEach(clean);
    });
  }
  if (document.readyState === "complete") run();
  else window.addEventListener("load", run);
})();
</script>



<!-- webview script -->
<script>
(function () {
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  var hasSourceApp = params.get('source') === 'app';
  var isInfinitePayUA = /InfinitePayApp/i.test(navigator.userAgent);
  var storageKey = 'force_source_app';

  if (hasSourceApp || isInfinitePayUA) {
    sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey, '1');
  }

  var shouldForceApp = sessionStorage.getItem(storageKey) === '1';

  if (!shouldForceApp) return;

  document.documentElement.classList.add('is-webview');

  if (params.get('source') !== 'app') {
    params.set('source', 'app');
    var newUrl =
      window.location.pathname +
      '?' +
      params.toString() +
      window.location.hash;
    history.replaceState(null, '', newUrl);
  }

  function patchLink(a) {
    var href = a.getAttribute('href');
    if (!href || href.startsWith('#') || href.startsWith('javascript:')) return;

    var url = new URL(href, window.location.origin);
    if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return;

    url.searchParams.set('source', 'app');
    a.setAttribute('href', url.pathname + url.search + url.hash);
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(patchLink);

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href]');
    if (a) patchLink(a);
  }, true);

  document.querySelectorAll('form[method="get"]').forEach(function (form) {
    var action = form.getAttribute('action') || window.location.pathname;
    var url = new URL(action, window.location.origin);
    if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return;

    var input = form.querySelector('input[name="source"]');
    if (!input) {
      input = document.createElement('input');
      input.type = 'hidden';
      input.name = 'source';
      form.appendChild(input);
    }
    input.value = 'app';
  });
})();
</script>
